cover_headline: Flying Home for Diwali and Chhath: 72% of Travellers Say Fares Are Higher This Year
facts: 72% of travellers flying home for the festivals are paying more than in 2025, in a LocalCircles survey of 19,993 travellers across 277 districts
Fares to Patna for November 7 run Rs 17,000 to Rs 28,000 one-way from major metros, up to three times usual levels
Fuel surcharges of Rs 400 to Rs 1,200 on domestic tickets from October 9 and reduced capacity are compounding festive demand

end.headline: Flying Home for Diwali and Chhath: 72% of Travellers Say Fares Are Higher This Year
end.line: Most festive flyers are paying more than in 2025, with Patna-bound tickets for November 7 at Rs 17,000-28,000.
